records.text: Operating revenues increased $420.5 million, or 45.6%, to $1,343.2 million for the third quarter of 2022, as compared to the third quarter of 2021, primarily due to an increase in average yield of 23.6%, an increase in traffic of 17.8% and an increase in load factor of 5.7 pts, year over year.
